disclosure: Curated explanatory labels and layout only. Action, variable, property, source-line, state-space, and transition data are regenerated from the pinned TLA+ modules, TLC configurations, checked evidence, and TLC DOT dumps.

member_local_restart.title: Independent member respawn
member_local_restart.description: Disable whole-appliance exit after required-role loss.

stop_without_fence.title: Stop before authority fence
stop_without_fence.description: Allow selected-Core replacement to stop before route and effect authority are fenced.

fallback_after_effect.title: Fallback after irreversible effect
fallback_after_effect.description: Allow LKG consumption after the pre-effect safety boundary.

caller_selected_scope.title: Payload-selected child parent
caller_selected_scope.description: Trust caller-selected lifecycle parentage instead of deriving the child parent from the authenticated Ark connection.

transitive_teardown.title: Transitive teardown authority
transitive_teardown.description: Leak a grandchild teardown edge to the root ancestor instead of granting it only to the direct lifecycle parent.

second_root_boot.title: Second parentless host Ark
second_root_boot.description: Allow ProcMan to boot a second local Ark without lifecycle parentage.

implicit_parent_peer.title: Implicit parent peer session
implicit_parent_peer.description: Treat lifecycle parentage as receiver authority for a peer session.

volume_before_release.title: Candidate writer before release
volume_before_release.description: Attach the candidate writer while the incumbent writer is still authoritative.

composition_wrong_provenance.title: Wrong snapshot provenance
composition_wrong_provenance.description: Allow the ordinary Chamber projection to attach a different snapshot than the one sealed.

composition_effect_without_admission.title: Effect without current admission
composition_effect_without_admission.description: Allow a base effect without a live admission bound to the current Core epoch.

composition_vault_blocks_base.title: Vault-coupled base readiness
composition_vault_blocks_base.description: Make ordinary base readiness depend on Vault availability instead of exact admission.

composition_stale_upgrade_authority.title: Stale authority after upgrade
composition_stale_upgrade_authority.description: Allow old-epoch authority to survive the generation cutover.

ark_core_appliance.title: Ark Core Appliance
ark_core_appliance.summary: One OCI/gVisor appliance starts its required internal roles in order, opens authority only on aggregate readiness, and recovers or terminalizes as one unit.
ark_core_appliance.question: When can one Ark safely admit work, recover, or replace its selected Core?
ark_core_appliance.property_description: Under weak fairness for deterministic lifecycle actions, every Off, Starting, Fenced, Crashed, or Recovery state eventually reaches Ready or Terminal.

aggregation.label: TLC states grouped by appliance mode

Off.label: Off
Off.description: No appliance task owns the scope. A cold boundary may read the durable selector exactly once.

Starting.label: Starting
Starting.description: The task owns its scope attachments while Engine, Persistence, Gateway, and Supervisor become ready in order.

Ready.label: Ready
Ready.description: Aggregate readiness, route generation, and effect ownership agree; admission may be open.

Fenced.label: Fenced
Fenced.description: Route and effect authority are closed before a selected-Core replacement stops the appliance.

Crashed.label: Crashed
Crashed.description: A required-role or activation failure has stopped the entire appliance and closed authority.

Recovery.label: Recovery
Recovery.description: Attachments and descendants have been reaped; policy chooses cached restart, one-use safe fallback, or terminal evidence.

Terminal.label: Terminal
Terminal.description: The bounded recovery policy has stopped with inspectable evidence instead of silently continuing.

ColdReadAndStartTask.description: At an Off boundary, cold-read the selected Core, cache that plan, and acquire the task's scope attachments.

StartRole.description: Start the next required role in the fixed Engine, Persistence, Gateway, Supervisor order.

InstallAggregateReadiness.description: Bind ProcMan registration and route evidence to the current task epoch once every required role is ready.

OpenAdmission.description: Open admission and effect authority only when all aggregate readiness evidence agrees.

CreateOrdinaryDescendant.description: Create ordinary descendant work only while the appliance is Ready and admission is open.

CommitSuccessorSelection.description: Durably select the successor Core without changing the already cached running plan.

FenceForSelectionChange.description: Close route, admission, and effect authority before replacing the cached Core.

StopScopeForSelectionChange.description: Stop and release the fenced appliance so the next Off boundary can cold-read the successor.

RequiredRoleFailure.description: A required-role process exit or semantic readiness loss stops the whole appliance, closes authority, and records the failed role and source.

MemberLocalRespawn.description: Deliberately unsafe control reachable only when whole-appliance failure handling is disabled; the checked production configuration makes it unreachable.

FailStartingRole.description: An activation-time role failure exits the whole appliance before admission.

MarkIrreversibleActivationEffect.description: Record the point after which an activation failure is no longer safe for automatic LKG fallback.

ReapCrashedScope.description: Reap descendants and release route, network, and volume ownership from the crashed epoch.

RestartCachedSelection.description: Restart the exact cached plan after a crash, even if a newer durable selector is pending.

ApplyAuthorizedLKG.description: Consume the one-use LKG permit only before admission and irreversible effects.

TerminalizeRecovery.description: Stop with inspectable terminal evidence when fallback is unsafe or retries are exhausted.

invariants.TypeOK: Every model variable remains inside its declared bounded domain.
invariants.S6StartupOrder: Persistence follows Engine; Gateway follows Persistence; Supervisor follows Gateway.
invariants.SingleAuthoritativeVolumeWriter: At most one task epoch holds the authoritative volume.
invariants.LiveTaskOwnsOneScopeAttachment: A live task has exactly its own volume/network attachment and a cached Core.
invariants.AdmissionRequiresAggregateReadiness: Admission implies one live, fully ready, generation-aligned appliance.
invariants.EffectsRequireReadyAppliance: Effect authority implies Ready, admitted, all-role evidence for the current epoch.
invariants.RequiredRoleFailureStopsWholeAppliance: Required-role loss leaves no live member, admission, or effect owner behind.
invariants.FallbackIsPreAdmissionPreEffect: Consumed LKG fallback is proven to be before admission and irreversible effects.
invariants.DescendantsStayWithinScopeLifetime: Ordinary descendants remain bounded by the live or failed scope lifetime.

scenarios.title: Cold start to admission
scenarios.description: One cold read, four ordered StartRole transitions, aggregate evidence, then authority.

scenarios.title: Whole-appliance crash recovery
scenarios.description: Required-role loss closes the whole scope; recovery reuses the cached plan.

scenarios.title: Selected-Core replacement
scenarios.description: A committed successor waits behind an explicit fence, stop, and next cold read.

scenarios.title: Pre-effect LKG fallback
scenarios.description: An activation failure can consume LKG only before admission or irreversible effects.

multi_ark.title: Single-root Multi-Ark
multi_ark.eyebrow: One host root · explicit descendants · ordinary peers
multi_ark.summary: ProcMan boots one parentless host-root Ark. Authenticated Arks may create isolated descendants; direct parentage grants teardown only, while local and remote communication uses one receiver-authorized peer session mechanism.
multi_ark.question: Can one host root create isolated descendants and communicate across every topology without turning connectivity into administration?
multi_ark.property_description: Under weak fairness, every starting scope becomes Ready and every crashed scope is reaped while root uniqueness, direct-child teardown, attachment isolation, and receiver-authorized peer sessions remain invariant.

aggregation.label: TLC states grouped by host root / child / grandchild phase tuple

BootDirect.description: Boot the sole parentless host root; the unsafe control separately demonstrates why no other local Ark may boot directly.

CreateChild.description: Create an isolated child whose lifecycle parent comes from the authenticated live Ark caller.

MarkScopeReady.description: Mark one scope Ready and create only that scope's local route.

IssuePeerInvite.description: The receiver issues an identity-bound invitation to one calling Ark, independent of lifecycle topology.

RevokePeerInvite.description: Revoke the outstanding receiver invitation without granting or changing lifecycle authority.

OpenPeerSession.description: Open one ordinary Ark peer session only against the receiver's matching invitation.

ClosePeerSession.description: Close the peer session without changing lifecycle or attachment authority.

StopDirectChild.description: Exercise the one parent-specific power: stop an exact direct child's active subtree.

CrashScope.description: Crash one scope and its active descendants, revoking their routes and peer state.

ReapScope.description: Release a crashed leaf scope's attachments and exact teardown edge before reuse.

invariants.TypeOK: Every per-scope variable remains inside its bounded domain.
invariants.EachScopeKeepsItsOwnAttachments: Every active scope has its expected private volume and network.
invariants.DistinctActiveScopeAttachments: Different active scopes never share a volume or private network.
invariants.OnlyScopeLocalRoutes: Every stable route begins and ends in the same scope.
invariants.OneHostRoot: Only RootArk may be active without lifecycle parentage.
invariants.EveryActiveChildDescendsFromRoot: Every active child has a valid active parent and therefore descends from the host root.
invariants.ChildCreationComesFromAuthenticatedCalle: The child parent and teardown edge agree with the authenticated creating caller.
invariants.DirectChildTeardownOnly: Every teardown edge is exact, immediate-parent scoped, and targets an active child.
invariants.PeerSessionRequiresReceiverInvite: A peer session exists only for the receiver's matching invitation.
invariants.PeerSessionCreatesNoPrivateRoute: Peer connectivity never creates a private scope route.
invariants.ReapedScopesAreDetached: A reaped scope retains no attachments, routes, teardown edge, or peer session.

structure_nodes.label: Host ProcMan
structure_nodes.description: Boots exactly one configured parentless host-root Ark and provisions child contexts only on authenticated Ark requests.

structure_nodes.label: Host root
structure_nodes.description: The sole parentless local Ark and an ordinary peer participant.

structure_nodes.label: Child Ark
structure_nodes.description: Lifecycle provenance grants its direct parent only exact subtree teardown, not observation or connectivity.

structure_nodes.label: Second descendant
structure_nodes.description: The bounded model explores both a second root child and a child of Child Ark.

structure_nodes.label: Remote Ark
structure_nodes.description: Uses the same receiver-authorized peer mechanism as parent/child and sibling pairs.

scenarios.title: One root creates descendants
scenarios.description: ProcMan boots one host root; live Ark callers create isolated child contexts from authenticated connections.

scenarios.title: Topology-neutral peer session
scenarios.description: Receiver invitation, session open, and close are identical for parent/child, siblings, and remote Arks.

scenarios.title: Exact direct-child teardown
scenarios.description: A parent can stop its direct child's subtree but receives no peer session or private route from parentage.

scenarios.title: Scope-tree recovery
scenarios.description: Crash revokes the affected subtree; leaves reap before a child can be created again.

host_cutover.title: Replacement-Host Cutover
host_cutover.summary: A candidate appliance validates privately before the incumbent is fenced, its writer is released, and production authority moves once.
host_cutover.question: Can a replacement host become authoritative without two writers or a private candidate leaking production authority?
host_cutover.property_description: Once an authorized cutover starts, weak fairness over fence, release, attach, readiness, and grant reaches candidate ProductionReady.

aggregation.label: Exact TLC state chain grouped by incumbent / candidate phase tuple

Init.label: Incumbent live
Init.description: The incumbent owns production writer, route, effects, and outer ingress.

ProvisionPrivateCandidate.label: Private start
ProvisionPrivateCandidate.description: The candidate starts without production writer, route, effects, or ingress.

ValidatePrivateCandidate.label: Private ready
ValidatePrivateCandidate.description: The candidate proves private readiness while remaining non-authoritative.

CompletePrivateCrashRebootRehearsal.label: Rehearsed
CompletePrivateCrashRebootRehearsal.description: The private candidate completes a crash/reboot rehearsal and returns Off.

BeginCutover.label: Cutover armed
BeginCutover.description: Cutover begins only after validation and rehearsal; incumbent authority is still intact.

FenceIncumbentAuthority.label: Incumbent fenced
FenceIncumbentAuthority.description: Route, effects, and outer ingress are removed before writer release.

ReleaseIncumbentWriter.label: Writer released
ReleaseIncumbentWriter.description: The fenced incumbent stops and releases the production writer lease.

AttachCandidateProductionWriter.label: Candidate attached
AttachCandidateProductionWriter.description: Only after release, the candidate starts on the production writer generation.

CandidateAggregateReady.label: Candidate ready
CandidateAggregateReady.description: The candidate proves aggregate readiness for the exact writer generation.

GrantCandidateAuthority.label: Authority moved
GrantCandidateAuthority.description: Route, effects, and outer ingress move together to the ready candidate.

RetireIncumbent.label: Incumbent retired
RetireIncumbent.description: The stopped incumbent retires after the candidate owns production authority.

ProvisionPrivateCandidate.description: Start the candidate on non-authoritative private resources.

ValidatePrivateCandidate.description: Mark private candidate validation without granting any production ownership.

CompletePrivateCrashRebootRehearsal.description: Prove a private crash/reboot cycle before cutover may begin.

BeginCutover.description: Arm the cutover only after private validation and rehearsal.

FenceIncumbentAuthority.description: Remove incumbent route, effect, and outer-ingress authority.

ReleaseIncumbentWriter.description: Release the incumbent's production writer after authority is fenced.

AttachCandidateProductionWriter.description: Attach the candidate writer only after the incumbent writer is gone.

CandidateAggregateReady.description: Prove candidate readiness for the exact attached writer generation.

GrantCandidateAuthority.description: Grant route, effect, and outer-ingress ownership together to the candidate.

RetireIncumbent.description: Retire the stopped incumbent after authority has moved.

invariants.TypeOK: Every host, phase, owner, and generation remains inside its bounded domain.
invariants.SingleAuthoritativeWriter: At most one production writer exists.
invariants.SingleRouteOwner: At most one production route owner exists.
invariants.SingleEffectOwner: At most one effect owner exists.
invariants.AuthorityOwnersAgree: Route, effect, and outer-ingress ownership move as one authority set.
invariants.AuthorityRequiresReadyWriter: Production authority requires a ready host on the exact writer generation.
invariants.PrivateCandidateHasNoProductionAuthority: Private validation never grants writer, route, effect, or ingress ownership.
invariants.CandidateAuthorityRequiresProof: Candidate authority requires validation, rehearsal, and exclusive writer ownership.
invariants.FencedIncumbentCannotRegainAuthority: After fencing begins, the incumbent cannot regain production authority.

scenarios.title: Validated single-writer cutover
scenarios.description: Private proof precedes fence, release, writer attach, readiness, and authority grant.

baseline_composition.title: Baseline Seam Composition
baseline_composition.summary: A bounded compatibility kernel joins mutable authoring, immutable snapshot access by an ordinary Chamber, provider revision, Builder artifact, Prepared Realization, fresh admission, optional Vault, base effect, and one-way generation upgrade.
baseline_composition.question: Do the independently owned baseline seams preserve exact provenance and current authority when composed?
baseline_composition.property_description: Under the declared weak fairness, the bounded composed baseline eventually reaches a completed successor cutover.

aggregation.label: TLC states grouped by composed baseline phase

Mutable.label: Mutable workspace
Mutable.description: Authoring remains mutable and cannot yet leave the source workspace.

Fenced.label: Workspace fenced
Fenced.description: The writer is closed before any immutable snapshot is sealed.

Sealed.label: Snapshot sealed
Sealed.description: One exact immutable snapshot is available.

SnapshotAttached.label: Snapshot projected
SnapshotAttached.description: An ordinary Chamber receives only the exact snapshot projection.

Committed.label: Provider revision
Committed.description: The ordinary Chamber derives one provider revision with exact provenance.

Built.label: Artifact built
Built.description: A constrained Builder derives one artifact and receipt.

Prepared.label: Realization prepared
Prepared.description: The artifact is recorded as one Prepared Realization.

Reserved.label: Activation reserved
Reserved.description: A fresh activation is reserved for the exact realization and epoch.

Identified.label: Ephemeral identity
Identified.description: The activation owns a fresh ephemeral PeerId.

Admitted.label: Activation admitted
Admitted.description: The exact public identity projection is admitted for the current epoch.

Ready.label: Base ready
Ready.description: Base readiness follows admission and remains independent of Vault.

Effected.label: Effect recorded
Effected.description: A base effect is attributable to the current admitted activation.

UpgradePrepared.label: Upgrade prepared
UpgradePrepared.description: A distinct successor generation is prepared without moving current authority.

UpgradeReady.label: Successor ready
UpgradeReady.description: The successor is ready for one fenced cutover.

Complete.label: Cutover complete
Complete.description: The new epoch, identity, admission, and route are current and old authority is fenced.

FenceWorkspace.description: Close mutable authoring before snapshot creation.

SealWorkspace.description: Seal one exact immutable source snapshot.

AttachSnapshotToOrdinaryChamber.description: Grant an ordinary Chamber the exact snapshot projection without writer authority.

CreateProviderRevision.description: Derive one provider revision from the projected snapshot.

BuildArtifact.description: Produce one artifact from the exact provider revision.

RecordPrepared.description: Record the artifact as one Prepared Realization.

ReserveActivation.description: Reserve one activation for the prepared realization and current epoch.

GenerateEphemeralPeer.description: Create one fresh ephemeral PeerId for the activation.

AdmitActivation.description: Admit the exact public activation projection and open current route ownership.

SetVaultAvailable.description: Make Vault available without changing ordinary base readiness.

IssueVaultLease.description: Issue an optional Vault lease to the current admitted activation.

MarkBaseReady.description: Mark base readiness from exact admission rather than Vault availability.

PerformEffect.description: Record one effect attributable to the current admitted epoch.

PrepareUpgrade.description: Prepare a distinct successor while current authority remains unchanged.

CutoverUpgrade.description: Move route, identity, admission, and epoch together while fencing old authority.

invariants.TypeOK: Every phase and provenance, identity, readiness, lease, and authority variable stays in its bounded domain.
invariants.ExactIdentityChain: Snapshot, revision, artifact, prepared realization, and activation provenance remain exact end to end.
invariants.EffectsRequireCurrentAdmission: A base effect requires live admission for the current Core epoch and routed realization.
invariants.BaseLifecycleIndependentOfVault: Ordinary base readiness follows admission and does not require Vault.
invariants.UpgradeCutoverFencesOldAuthority: A completed upgrade installs the fresh epoch and identity while revoking old authority and any old Vault lease.
invariants.OnlyImmutableSourceLeavesWorkspace: Only a sealed immutable snapshot may cross the mutable-workspace boundary.

scenarios.title: Base lifecycle without Vault
scenarios.description: Immutable source provenance reaches admitted effect and successor cutover without requiring a Vault lease.

scenarios.title: Optional exact Vault lease
scenarios.description: Vault may become available and lease to the admitted activation without becoming base readiness authority.
